notes.title: V1.0.0 - FULL RELEASE
notes.content:
[h2]LAST BOSS[/h2]
The last boss has been added to the game

[h2]RED MODE[/h2]
The most difficult game mode was added to the game, only unlocked after finishing the campaign.

notes.title: UPDATE V0.3.0
notes.content:
[h3]New Intro[/h3]
The introduction has been improved to give a deeper background on the story.

[h3]New Menu Map[/h3]
A new menu map has been added.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
A bug that caused map transitions to slow down has been fixed.

notes.title: DRONE FOREST
notes.content:
The last level, Drone Forest, is now available in the game.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
Improved performance in the first Relic Dungeon.
Fixed a bug in some enemies rotations.
Improved performance in Buff Nest Level.
New Achievement available in Buff Nest.

notes.title: 2.5D UPDATE
notes.content:
Almost all levels are now 2.5D sidescroller, except by the Relic Dungeons and some special maps.
That's how the game was envisioned at beginning.

notes.title: Linux Version and Steam Deck Support
notes.content:
[h2]LINUX AND STEAM DECK VERSION[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Linux version for Reddish has been released, now it's possible to play using Steam Deck.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES AND OPTIMIZATION[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with low settings on the Steam Deck where the ocean texture would not work properly.
[*] Imputs for dash and block have been changed to became more intuitive.
[*] Fixed an issue with the game over screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with the life display in the HUD.
[*] Other small fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Narbash House + New Relic Dungeon
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Narbash's house after Armyrn forest has been added.

It is possible to buy clues of relics from Narbash, in his house after Amyrn Forest. These clues will never tell you exactly where the relic and relic dungeons are, but they will give you a better sense of where you need to look.
[/list]
[list]
[*]A new secret relic dungeon has been added to the world.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: A bug on ladders that caused them to disappear in some levels has been fixed.
